'''Kombat''' is a one-day 4on4 mini-tournament played at '''Wednesday 11th August''', 21:00 {{Abbr/CEST}}.
The ambition is to bring more quick and easy tournaments into Quakeworld that doesn't require scheduling for each and every match. 

Sign-up at <mark>#sign-up</mark> on [http://discord.gg/R6nkeCjvEB discord]
== Format ==
* 4on4, Single-Elimination
* 4 teams
* All matches are {{Abbr|BO3|Best of 3}} 
* Map: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/wiki/Phantom_Base PHANTOM BASE] by {{Player|QuakeR|flag=nl}}
== Rules ==
* European tournament (other regions are welcome but EU servers are prioritized for lowest ping)
* Client: ezQuake
* Ruleset: smackdown/qcon
* Reporting: send screenshots in [http://discord.gg/R6nkeCjvEB discord] channel: <mark>#kombat</mark>, or message {{Player|Alice|flag=se}}
